cands.name: Erin Huntley
cands.bio: Orange County Republican Party chair, age 46, mother of three. Worked for Walt Disney Parks, JetBlue and DECA; DeSantis appointee to the Florida Virtual School board of trustees (campaign site).
cands.local_ties: Says she has raised her family in Central Florida for nearly two decades (campaign site).

record.text: Chairs the Orange County Republican Party (Florida Politics); appointed by Gov. DeSantis to the Florida Virtual School Board of Trustees (campaign site).

money_notes.text: Raised more than $252,000 through 2025 via her campaign and her political committee Conservative Solutions for Florida; Q4 2025 donors included Associated Industries of Florida PAC, Florida Podiatry Political Committee, Florida Chiropractic Society and Florida Credit Union PAC.

endorsements.text: U.S. Rep. Daniel Webster and the Reedy Creek Professional Firefighters (IAFF Local 2117).
Wilton Simpson, Mike Haridopolos and James Uthmeier (per Florida Politics headlines); her site also lists Florida Professional Firefighters, Florida FOP and Florida PBA.

cands.gaps: No clean headshot (site has only a campaign graphic). Worklist home-county code (ALA) does not match the Central Florida ties in campaign materials; filing address not verified. 2026 fundraising total not retrieved. Owner sources: only alexjoneslive.com on-site search was run for this name (no results); stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com on-site searches are bot-blocked and the web-search budget ran out, so those were not checked.

cands.name: Leonard Spencer
cands.bio: Gotha Democrat, 55; first-term House member since Nov. 2024; the only Democrat to flip a Florida House seat that year (51%, about 1,600 votes). Former Disney executive (2005-21), now at Amazon; Tuskegee B.S., University of Alabama MBA.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Gotha; born in Jacksonville, raised in Mobile, Ala. (Wikipedia).

record.text: Sponsored HB 1093 (2026), which became law and lets vertiports qualify for public-private partnerships.
Beat Republican Rep. Carolina Amesty in 2024; HD 45 voters narrowly preferred Trump in 2024.

money_notes.text: Through 2025: about $38,000 in hard money plus $96,600 raised by his political committee Friends of Leonard Spencer since 2024.

cands.gaps: No endorsement list found. 2026 fundraising totals not retrieved. Biography from Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonard_Spencer). The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
